backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor providing story submission, comments, user profiles, authorization checks, and admin moderation logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing added frontend features with associated files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining canister roles, usage of frontend vs backend IDs, and deployment troubleshooting.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining OKLCH color tokens, themes, and base styles for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React application root and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines TanStack Router routes and renders the application with a shared layout.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedStat: UI component showing an access-denied message with navigation back to the stories page.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Top navigation header with site branding and links to main pages including story submission.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Wraps pages with header, footer, and consistent layout structure including links and contact info.
Form component for submitting comments using a mutation hook with validation and error handling.
frontend/src/components/CommentThread.ts: Displays comments for a story with loading skeletons and fallback messaging; currently shows no comments because the backend lacks retrieval support.
frontend/src/components/FeedDiagnosticsP: Shows canister IDs and raw URLs with copy and open actions to help diagnose connectivity issues.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides admin hooks for fetching all stories and publishing reworded stories, with cache invalidation on updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAvailabilit: Checks backend heartbeat status on demand and returns reachability state and errors.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Handles Internet Identity auth state, login, logout, and identity persistence using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useStories.ts: Provides hooks to fetch stories, submit stories, handle retries, and add comments, with comment fetching currently returning an empty list.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes with custom typography and focus rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the app by mounting React, providing QueryClient and InternetIdentity contexts.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Displays an About Me section with background information on the author and contact details.
frontend/src/pages/AdminModerationPage.t: Provides an admin interface to review, edit, and publish submitted stories, handling loading, errors, and authorization.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Fetches and displays published stories with detailed error handling and backend availability diagnostics.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Shows the homepage with a hero section and feature cards, guiding users to read or submit stories.
frontend/src/pages/StoryDetailPage.tsx: Displays a full story with metadata and includes a comments section with loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitStoryPage.tsx: Provides a form for submitting a story, supporting anonymous submissions and handling success or error states.
frontend/src/pages/TroubleshootingPage.t: React page that displays canister troubleshooting info, showing resolved IDs, URLs, and error states with copy-to-clipboard helpers.
frontend/src/utils/canisterUrls.ts: Utility for detecting frontend and backend canister IDs from hostname or env and generating standard/raw access URLs.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility for reading URL parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning them from the hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, animations, and plugin usage.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current IC deployment issues, architecture notes, and feature requirements for improved diagnostics.
